verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents its own programmatic surfaces: a TypeScript plugin API with a Vault interface for working with files and folders, an Obsidian URI scheme for triggering actions such as opening or creating notes, and a headless Sync client aimed at agents and automated workflows. A community user also reports using the API to extract metadata. However, the URI scheme covers only a few actions, the plugin API runs inside the app rather than as an external API, and nothing claims or shows parity with the UI. missing for 10: documented UI/API parity, an external programmatic API (e.g. REST or CLI) covering features like Bases, Graph, Publish and settings, independent hands-on confirmation of agent-driven full control.
